actionAdapters.when: 修改已经冻结的文本或字体源条目
更新已确认的本地化设置或既有 UI 绑定
导出确认范围内的文本、字体、类型或支持语言产物
复用已确认的本地化导出 Batch
在 Play Mode 中切换冻结的验证语言

allow: confirmed localization text or font source entries
confirmed LocalizationComponent settings through Unity Editor or MCP
confirmed existing TextLocalizing bindings through Unity Editor or MCP
confirmed localization generated text, font, type and supported-language output
deny: manual edits to generated localization output
global FixMissingInPrefabs scan or unrelated localization source and binding

requiredFor: ambiguous source entry, Key, language, FontMark, output path or target binding
add or remove Key, language, FontMark, supported language, data format or fallback rule
replace non-generated asset or change a TextLocalizing binding
delete, external write, credential use, Git commit or push
confirmation.rule: 确认绑定源数据范围、已有 UI 绑定、导出范围和验证语言；任一范围变化后旧确认失效。

evidence: 定向源数据与既有 TextLocalizing 绑定 diff
选定文本、字体、类型和语言列表导出结果
Unity 编译和 Play Mode 双语言切换证据
